movie.title: Whiplash
movie.overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.

facts: The film's title, 'Whiplash,' cleverly refers to more than just intense drumming! It's also the medical term for a neck injury, subtly hinting at the physical and emotional toll within the story.
At its heart, 'Whiplash' introduces us to a truly talented young drummer who's dead set on achieving perfection, no matter the personal cost.
Be ready for a gripping dynamic between this drummer and his ruthless instructor, who pushes him so hard that even his humanity is on the line!
